payload.title: ADR 0014: One variant per channel, shared by slot time
payload.context: M5 (#5): one idea should produce one variant per channel, edited side by side.
payload.rationale: Channels with a slot at the same instant share one post with a text for each; slots at different times get separate posts. Variants of a post share one planned and firing time and one approval, because the claim, the publishing round and stuck-post recovery are per post and that is what keeps publishing idempotent. Prompt v2 is the default and writes each text for its own channel; v1 is frozen. Platform conventions stay data: capabilities and voice rules.
alternatives: Join slots on the same day
payload.consequences: One idea on every channel needs the same slot time. Per-variant times or approvals would need a state machine change.
